name: Roll-Keeper Hesk
lore: Keeps the Roll of Names at Wardens' Rest: every settlement in the basin, written and read aloud once a season so that none of them can go quiet. Has ink on three fingers permanently and will tell you which three.
unique_habit: Reads one page of the Roll aloud to the empty room before locking up, always a different page, never the page anyone asks for.

name: Sergeant Dole
lore: Twenty-one years a Warden, most of them on the Larkbourne road. Believes the Roll is a tool and not a scripture, which is the kind of opinion that ends careers at the Rest.
unique_habit: Walks the Larkbourne road as far as the fallen tower and back every morning he is at the Rest, in all weather, and has never once said why.

name: Ryn Larkbourne
lore: Had a name, a band named after the name, and a stolen mill wheel for a table. Since the ink went through the page, people have begun to forget the face over an evening, and Ryn has begun to notice them doing it.
unique_habit: Says their own name under their breath at every doorway they go through, the way other people touch a lintel.

schedule.notes: camped in the chalk pit under the Chalk Hound, at the head of the stolen wheel
